description: This file defines a module for managing a Signal daemon process, including spawning, monitoring, and handling logs and exit events.

methods.name: formatSignalDaemonExit
methods.description: Formats a SignalDaemonExitEvent into a human-readable string.

methods.name: classifySignalCliLogLine
methods.description: Classifies a log line from signal-cli as 'log', 'error', or null.

methods.name: spawnSignalDaemon
methods.description: Spawns and manages a Signal daemon process, returning a handle to control it.
